sf-amenity-phones.summary: Fire-station and library cards carry no phone number.
sf-amenity-phones.why: The city's fire station and library datasets have no phone number in them — it's missing at the source, not undisplayed.
sf-amenity-phones.wanted: An SFFD station or SFPL branch dataset that includes public phone numbers.

sf-congress-district-offices.summary: Congressional cards show the Washington D.C. office only, not the local district office.
sf-congress-district-offices.why: The roster this card is built from publishes the Washington office and not the local district ones.
sf-congress-district-offices.wanted: Nothing new from readers — the enrichment is a recorded builder-scope follow-up; the entry stays only until the card shows the district office.

sf-supervisor-contact.summary: Supervisor districts name the supervisor but the boundary source carries no contact fields.
sf-supervisor-contact.why: The city's supervisor district data carries no contact details, so a phone or e-mail has to come from a separate roster.
sf-supervisor-contact.wanted: A DataSF or Board of Supervisors dataset with per-district office phone and e-mail.
